settings.description: U5 isolated: with the pixel-domain search fixed, the only thing that matters is what error means. refine_obj=3 weights the clipped-OKLAB L term by refine_wl and the chroma terms by refine_wc, so this walks the objective from pixel-accurate (wc low) to colour-accurate (wc high) and finds where dE00 stops improving. Run on the shipped 32 B layout and on the retuned 4-bit one.
